title: Policy 463.10 audits — April/May 2026 continuation
summary: Temporal follow-up to W012461-040226. Asks for the April and May 2026 monthly audit memoranda under Policy § 463.10, plus any audit records covering the separate quarterly audit of external CA public agency users that § 463.10 describes.

policy_promises.quote: an audit is conducted of ALPR data searches at least monthly for internal ALPR users and quarterly for external CA public agency users
policy_promises.tests: What records exist for the April and May 2026 monthly audits, and for any quarterly external-user audit?

policy_promises.quote: the memorandum and any associated documentation shall be filed and retained
policy_promises.tests: What 'associated documentation' (review notes, intermediate query results, draft memoranda) is retained alongside each memo?

prior_pra_refs.note: W012461 produced four monthly internal-user audit memos (Dec 2025–Mar 2026). This request covers the April/May 2026 continuation and any external-CA-public-agency-user audit records.

filed_because: Asks for the continued monthly cadence and the separate external-user audit records the policy describes.
notes:
The four memos produced under W012461 describe audits of 'internal and external ALPR usage' with substantive content covering sharing configuration; item 3 asks for records of the separate external-user search-activity audit.

Response received 2026-05-14 (Juliana Santiago, Management Analyst, SMPD). Closed same day.
